when the committed copy is stale. Importing the app reads no settings or secrets, so this runs
anywhere the backend's dependencies are installed::

    uv run python -m app.openapi_schema ../frontend/packages/api-client/openapi.json
    uv run python -m app.openapi_schema            # print it instead
"""
